source.name: Destiny Data Compendium, Solar (Lightweight Knife)
source.quote: Precision Hits grant Radiant for 10 seconds.
source.note: Rule in scripts/lib/abilityGrants.ts: first number of "for N seconds" (without the bonus after "+" and the PvP value in brackets).

source.quote: Snare Bomb deals 33 [10] impact damage, and up to 120 + 24 [40 + ?] explosion damage over ? meters. Impact and explosion weaken and disorient for 8 [2.5] seconds.
source.note: Rule in scripts/lib/abilityGrants.ts: first number of "for N seconds" (without the bonus after "+" and the PvP value in brackets).
